main_text.p: ܩܥܐ ܟܝܢ Syr.Clamare,exclamare,vociferari.Idé quod Ch.נָעָא, Hebr. נעה, ג & פ inter se commutatis.
קעד ܟܪܥ Syr. Procidere, procumbere in genua,
ܟܪܥܘ ܘܟܪܥ Et procidit super genua sua,Act.9.39.& 21.5.
קפא Hebr.Concrescere,coagulari.Sic Chald. קפא Concreverunt,Exo.15.8. Præt. וקפא Et concrevit, coaluit sc.cum ferro, juxta Hebræos, 2.Reg. 6.6. Vide R.Sal.
ܟܦܐ, ܟܦܐ Act.8.28. ad Rom.12.16. sunt à ܢܟܦ, ex Imperat.
קפר Hebr.Præcîdit,Jesa.38.12. Ithpah. אתקפר Ithpeh. אתקפר Præcîdi,abbreviari,decurtari.
קפירור Ch. Brevitas, imminutio, angustia, Esa.59.1. Exo.6.9.in T.Jon.& Hierof.
קפרא Chal. Iracundia, quasi Brevitas, præcipitantia spiritus dicta,Num.25.8.in T.Hierof.

קופר, קופרא Ch. Ericius,erinaceus,echinus,juxta quosdam: Alii, Aquilam anatariam:Alii Fibrum seu Castorem:Alii Testitudinem; Alii Noctuam:Alii Lutram interpretantur. Resp. Hebr. קפור. Vide Nicol. Full.in Miscell.lib.1.c.18.Plur.קופרין.
קפורקיא Cappadocia. קפורקיא Cappadoces. Scribitur & cum ט in Targum.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek-like Oriental script rendered as closely as legible; several Syriac and Hebrew words are doubtful and not certain at this scan resolution. Show-through from the reverse page is present and omitted.
